AAREYDRUGS.technical: Trading above key daily moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 101.39 on 2x average volume. MACD is positive, but price action lacks a structured multi-week base or relative strength leadership.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Fundamentals breach core CANSLIM standards. Q1 FY27 revenue dropped 56.3% YoY to ₹44.6 Cr while net profit declined 25.3% to ₹1.0 Cr. Return profile is anemic with ROCE at 5.58% and ROE at 2.75%.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A breakdown below 92.26 invalidates the pivot structure; cut immediately to protect capital against severe downside drift in deteriorating fundamentals.

ACE.technical: Classic double-bottom pattern clearing neckline pressure at 1197.20 above rising 50-day and 200-day SMAs. Bullish candle engulfs prior selling on 1.16x average volume, showing constructive accumulation.
ACE.fundamental: Domestic leader in mobile cranes with >60% market share. Robust operational execution generated 20.5% sales growth to ₹785.7 Cr and 22.3% PAT growth. Exceptional capital efficiency with ROCE at 31.6%, ROE at 22.8%, and virtually zero debt.
ACE.risk: Failure below 1111.18 breaches the pattern low and EMA support; exit decisively to prevent compounded portfolio drag.

AEGISLOG.technical: High tight flag consolidation perched cleanly above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Entry trigger at 1499.30 is backed by 2.15x average volume and an RSI of 55, reflecting controlled institutional absorption without extended froth.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM profile. Massive operational scale in LPG terminalling and distribution drove Q1 FY27 PAT up 210% to ₹544 Cr on ₹2,357 Cr revenue (+37.1% YoY). Margins expanded sharply to 34.8% alongside multi-port capacity additions.
AEGISLOG.risk: Violation of 1376.44 support breaches the flag base; disciplined Minervini risk management requires immediate exit.

AMDIND.technical: Double bottom breakout attempt above 74.46 over key moving averages on 3.16x volume expansion. Momentum is positive with RSI at 67, but microcap liquidity introduces erratic execution slippage.
AMDIND.fundamental: Delivered sharp Q1 turnaround PAT of ₹9.1 Cr on ₹122 Cr revenue (+40.8% YoY). However, long-term fundamentals remain fragile with ROCE at 1.43%, negative ROE (-2.64%), and low interest coverage, falling short of elite institutional quality.
AMDIND.risk: A drop below 64.10 breaches the structural swing low and invalidates the base; exit immediately to manage risk.

ANANDRATHI.technical: Constructive double bottom consolidation retesting the 2257.25 pivot above rising 50-day and 200-day SMAs. Volume expanding at 1.41x with RSI 56, demonstrating firm relative strength against a soft market backdrop.
ANANDRATHI.fundamental: Premier wealth distributor with AUM crossing ₹1 lakh crore. Outstanding balance sheet strength with zero debt, ROCE of 57.5%, and ROE of 45.3%. Q1 FY27 PAT rose 24% YoY to ₹116 Cr, but EPS growth moderated from prior quarters.
ANANDRATHI.risk: A break beneath 2168.14 invalidates the double bottom trough; mandatory stop execution prevents deeper drawdown.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout into new 52-week highs at 884.73, clearing 20-session resistance on exceptional 9.82x volume. Price rides cleanly above rising moving averages, exhibiting powerful institutional demand.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: High Tech anti-counterfeiting solutions drove explosive Q1 FY27 revenue growth (+111% YoY to ₹87.8 Cr) and net profit growth (+151% YoY to ₹27.4 Cr). Operating margins rebounded to 41.4% with ROCE reaching 29.6% and negligible debt.
ARROWGREEN.risk: A close below 800.89 shatters the breakout bar; stop out immediately to preserve capital against false breakout risk.
